captions.LinkedIn:
Six documentary funding calls have dates between now and February. Two accept US-based producers directly.

Visions du Réel, VdR Pitching: final deadline 15 December 2026 (CHF 30 until 2 November, CHF 40 after). Feature films over 60 minutes in late development, from anywhere.

Sundance, Documentary Film Producers Track: opens 17 November, closes 10 February 2027. Lead producers with at least one documentary short.

The other four are for UK, New Zealand, Australian and European applicants.

I read each funder's own page on 17 October. Every date, with its time zone and a link, is here:
https://www.docudocket.live/blog/documentary-funding-deadlines-november-december-2026/

facts.claim: Visions du Réel VdR Pitching: final deadline, fees, eligibility
facts.evidence: Final deadline 15 December 2026. CHF 30 on or before 2 November 2026, CHF 40 from 3 November. Feature films over 60 minutes in late development. Projects from all over the world can apply.

facts.claim: Sundance Documentary Film Producers Track: dates and eligibility
facts.evidence: Opens 9am PT Tuesday 17 November 2026, closes 9am PT Wednesday 10 February 2027. Lead producers who have produced at least one documentary short, in active production or post. Non-US candidates must work and live in Europe or Latin America.

facts.claim: BFI Doc Society Development Fund Round 2
facts.evidence: Round 2 opens 1pm Monday 9 November 2026 and closes 1pm Monday 21 December 2026. UK filmmakers.

facts.claim: NZ Film Commission Feature Film Production Investment
facts.evidence: Deadline 1pm Monday 9 November. Lead producer must be a New Zealand citizen or permanent resident.
5pm AEDT Thursday 4 February 2027 and 5pm AEST Thursday 8 April 2027. Australian production companies.
Entries open 15 November, deadline 15 January 2027. European minority co-producers.
